meta.name: add-opencode
meta.description: Use OpenCode as an agent provider. OpenRouter, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, etc. via OpenCode config — not the Anthropic Agent SDK. Per group via `ncl groups config update --provider opencode`; host passes OPENCODE_* and XDG mount when spawning containers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 OpenCode 配置管理多种 AI 模型提供商
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在容器化环境中切换不同 AI 模型提供商
copy.tagline_en: Manage multiple AI model providers via OpenCode config
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to switch between AI model providers in containerized environments

howto.what: 安装后，NanoClaw 新增一个 opencode 代理提供商，代理组除了默认的 claude，也能选用它调用 OpenRouter、DeepSeek 等模型。
howto.when: 运行 `ncl groups config update --provider opencode` 并重启对应组后，该组代理会改用 opencode 提供商。

say.text: 为 NanoClaw 添加 OpenCode 代理提供商。
say.note: 运行 add-opencode，复制文件并重建镜像。

say.text: 把 group-a 的 provider 改成 opencode 并重启。
say.note: 切换该组的代理提供商到 opencode。

say.text: 配置 OpenCode 使用 DeepSeek 模型。
say.note: 写入 OPENCODE_PROVIDER 等环境变量。

howto.what_en: After installation, NanoClaw gains an 'opencode' agent provider. Agent groups can use it to call models like OpenRouter and DeepSeek, in addition to the default 'claude'.
howto.when_en: After running `ncl groups config update --provider opencode` and restarting the group, that group's agents will use the opencode provider.

say_en.text: Add the OpenCode agent provider to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Runs the skill, copies files, rebuilds image.

say_en.text: Set group-a's provider to opencode and restart.
say_en.note: Switches the agent provider via ncl groups config update.
Sets OPENCODE_PROVIDER and related env vars.
